# Notebook 50 -- Quantile mapping for the SSP projection series

**What this notebook does.** The SSP twin of `QED_20_qm_fit_apply.Rmd`
(which stays untouched). Per model x SSP x catchment x variable:

1. **Fit** seasonal EQM with the historical pair as training data:
   source = the model's **historical** catchment-mean aggregate
   (`agg_<var>_<model>.csv` from QED_05), reference = observed CAMELS-IND
   catchment-mean forcings, overlap = the full historical window
   1981--2014. Fitting on the full historical (not the ranking split) is the
   pre-registered projection-application choice (18 Nov 2026, header of
   `QED_40_ssp_aggregate.Rmd`): the out-of-sample fit/score discipline
   belongs to model *ranking*, not to projection *application*.
2. **Apply** each fitted mapping to the SSP aggregate
   (`data_processed/ssp/agg_<var>_<model>_<ssp>.csv` from QED_40, covering
   the three windows 2015--2040 / 2041--2060 / 2081--2100; the 2061--2080
   gap is source-NA by design and surfaces as `method_flag = "source_nan"`).
3. **Tail policy (pre-registered):** `pr` extrapolation is **"linear"**
   (constant clamping would truncate intensified future rainfall extremes);
   temperature stays "linear" as in the historical leg. This overrides
   `qed_extrap_pr <- "constant"` from QED_00 **for this notebook only** --
   every extrapolated value is still flagged, so downstream users can
   filter or downweight them.
4. **No silent drops:** every skip is a summary row AND a log line; flags
   (`within_range`, `extrapolated_low/high`, `source_nan`) propagate to
   `method_flag` in every output CSV exactly as in the historical leg.

Output layout (inside `data_processed/ssp/`):

```
qm_corrected/<model>/<ssp>/<tier>/<catchment_id>_<var>.csv   # date, source_value, corrected_value, method_flag
qm_params/<model>/<tier>/<catchment_id>_<var>.rds            # fitted quantile pairs (per historical fit)
qed_50_run_summary.csv                                       # one row per model x ssp x catchment x var
```

```{r log-file}
qed_ssp_dir <- file.path(qed_project_root, "data_processed", "ssp")
qed_ssp_log_file <- file.path(qed_ssp_dir, "qed_50_log.txt")
stopifnot(dir.exists(qed_ssp_dir))   # QED_40 must have produced the SSP aggs
```

## 0. Tail-policy override (pre-registered, dated)

```{r tail-policy}
# Pre-registered in QED_40_ssp_aggregate.Rmd (18 Nov 2026): SSP pr tail = linear
qed_extrap_pr <- "linear"
cat("pr tail policy for the SSP leg:", qed_extrap_pr,
    "(historical leg used 'constant' -- deliberate, dated override)\n")
```

## 1. Inputs: roster + historical aggs + SSP aggs

```{r load-inventory}
inventory <- data.table::fread(file.path(qed_output_dir, "inventory.csv"),
                               colClasses = list(character = "id"))
qm_catch <- inventory[final_action %in%
                         c("tier1", "tier2", "correct_with_warning")]
qm_catch[, tier := data.table::fifelse(final_action == "tier1", "tier1", "tier2")]
cat("Catchments to correct:", nrow(qm_catch), "\n")
```

```{r model-ssp-discovery, eval=TRUE}
# discover (model, ssp) pairs from the QED_40 output names:
# agg_<var>_<model>_<ssp>.csv ; model names contain "-" but not "_"
files_ssp <- list.files(qed_ssp_dir, pattern =
                           "^agg_(pr|tasmax|tasmin)_.+_ssp[0-9]+\\.csv$")
rows <- lapply(seq_along(files_ssp), function(i) {
   p <- strsplit(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files_ssp[i])), "_")[[1]]
   data.table::data.table(var = p[2],
                          model = paste(p[3:(length(p) - 1)], collapse = "_"),
                          ssp = p[length(p)], file = files_ssp[i])
})
meta <- data.table::rbindlist(rows, use.names = TRUE)
models_ssp <- sort(unique(meta$model))
ssps_all   <- sort(unique(meta$ssp))
cat("SSP agg files:", nrow(meta), "| models:", length(models_ssp),
    "| SSPs:", paste(ssps_all, collapse = ","), "\n")

# models must also have historical aggregates to fit on
hist_ok <- vapply(models_ssp, function(m) all(file.exists(
   file.path(qed_agg_dir, paste0("agg_", qed_vars, "_", m, ".csv")))),
   logical(1))
if (any(!hist_ok)) {
   drop_m <- models_ssp[!hist_ok]
   qed_log(paste("SKIP models without full historical aggs:",
                 paste(drop_m, collapse = ", ")), qed_ssp_log_file)
   meta <- meta[!model %in% drop_m]
   models_ssp <- models_ssp[hist_ok]
}
cat("Models to correct:", length(models_ssp), "\n")
```

```{r test-mode-override}
# explicit, visible test mode (mirror of QED_20's): set TRUE for a small
# run; production leaves it FALSE
qed50_test_mode <- FALSE
if (qed50_test_mode) {
   models_ssp <- models_ssp[1]
   meta <- meta[model == models_ssp & ssp == ssps_all[1]]
   qm_catch <- head(qm_catch, 5)
   cat("TEST MODE: 1 model x 1 ssp x 5 catchments\n")
}
```

## 2. Cache the reference forcings (read once)

```{r cache-forcing}
forcing_cache <- setNames(vector("list", nrow(qm_catch)), qm_catch$id)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(qm_catch))) {
   id <- qm_catch$id[i]
   f  <- qed_read_forcing(file.path(qed_forcing_dir, paste0(id, ".csv")))
   f  <- f[date >= qed_period_start & date <= qed_period_end]
   forcing_cache[[id]] <- f
}
```

## 3. Fit on the historical pair (once per model x catchment x var), then apply to every SSP

```{r main-loop, eval=TRUE}
dir.create(file.path(qed_ssp_dir, "qm_corrected"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(qed_ssp_dir, "qm_params"),    showWarnings = FALSE)

summary_rows <- list(); n_row <- 0L

for (model in models_ssp) {

   # ---- historical aggs (fit sources) + observed reference -------------------
   agg_pr  <- qed_read_agg(file.path(qed_agg_dir, paste0("agg_pr_",    model, ".csv")))
   agg_tx  <- qed_read_agg(file.path(qed_agg_dir, paste0("agg_tasmax_", model, ".csv")))
   agg_tn  <- qed_read_agg(file.path(qed_agg_dir, paste0("agg_tasmin_", model, ".csv")))
   hist_agg <- list(pr = agg_pr, tasmax = agg_tx, tasmin = agg_tn)

   # ---- fits: one per catchment x var, reused across all SSPs ----------------
   fits_cache <- setNames(vector("list", nrow(qm_catch)), qm_catch$id)
   for (i in seq_len(nrow(qm_catch))) {
      id  <- qm_catch$id[i]
      tier <- qm_catch$tier[i]
      par_dir <- file.path(qed_ssp_dir, "qm_params", model, tier)
      dir.create(par_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
      ref <- forcing_cache[[id]]
      fc <- list()
      for (var in qed_vars) {
         rcol <- qed_camels_var_cols[[var]]
         src_all  <- qed_get_series(hist_agg[[var]], id)
         src_date <- hist_agg[[var]]$dates
         in_win   <- src_date >= qed_period_start & src_date <= qed_period_end
         n_overlap_valid <- sum(!is.na(src_all[in_win]))
         if (n_overlap_valid < qed_min_days_for_qm) {
            fc[[var]] <- list(status = paste0("skipped_overlap_lt_",
                                              qed_min_days_for_qm),
                              n_overlap = n_overlap_valid)
            next
         }
         ref_w <- ref[[rcol]][ref$date %in% src_date[in_win]]
         fits  <- list(); bins_used <- character(0)
         s_lbl <- qed_date_to_season(src_date[in_win]); src_w <- src_all[in_win]
         for (s in names(qed_seasons)) {
            if (sum(s_lbl == s) >= qed_min_quantile_sample) {
               fits[[s]] <- qed_fit_eqm(src_w[s_lbl == s], ref_w, qed_n_quantiles)
               if (!is.null(fits[[s]])) bins_used <- c(bins_used, s)
            }
         }
         if (length(bins_used) < length(qed_seasons)) {
            fits[["annual"]] <- qed_fit_eqm(src_w, ref_w, qed_n_quantiles)
            if (!is.null(fits[["annual"]]))
               bins_used <- c(bins_used, "annual(fallback)")
         }
         fc[[var]] <- list(status = if ("annual(fallback)" %in% bins_used)
                              "fitted_annual_fallback" else "fitted",
                           fits = fits, bins = paste(bins_used, collapse = "+"),
                           n_overlap = n_overlap_valid)
      }
      fits_cache[[id]] <- fc
   }

   # ---- apply to each SSP series --------------------------------------------
   ssps_here <- sort(unique(meta[model == model, ssp]))
   for (s in ssps_here) {
      ssp_files <- meta[model == model & ssp == s]
      ssp_agg <- setNames(vector("list", 3), qed_vars)
      for (v in qed_vars) {
         fp <- ssp_files[var == v, file]
         if (!length(fp)) { ssp_agg[[v]] <- NULL; next }
         ssp_agg[[v]] <- qed_read_agg(file.path(qed_ssp_dir, fp))
      }

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(qm_catch))) {
         id <- qm_catch$id[i]; tier <- qm_catch$tier[i]
         out_dir <- file.path(qed_ssp_dir, "qm_corrected", model, s, tier)
         dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

         res <- tryCatch({
            for (var in qed_vars) {
               fc <- fits_cache[[id]][[var]]
               if (is.null(fc) || is.null(fc$fits)) {
                  summary_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <- data.frame(
                     model, ssp = s, id, var, tier,
                     status = if (is.null(fc)) "skipped_no_hist_fit"
                              else fc$status,
                     n_overlap = if (is.null(fc)) NA_integer_
                                 else fc$n_overlap,
                     n_extrap = NA_integer_,
                     frac_extrap = NA_real_)
                  next
               }
               if (is.null(ssp_agg[[var]])) {
                  summary_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <- data.frame(
                     model, ssp = s, id, var, tier, status = "skipped_ssp_agg_missing",
                     n_overlap = NA_integer_, n_extrap = NA_integer_,
                     frac_extrap = NA_real_)
                  next
               }
               src_all  <- qed_get_series(ssp_agg[[var]], id)
               src_date <- ssp_agg[[var]]$dates
               extrap <- switch(var, pr = qed_extrap_pr,
                                tasmax = qed_extrap_temp,
                                tasmin = qed_extrap_temp)

               appl <- data.table::data.table(
                  x_src = src_all, x_corrected = NA_real_,
                  within_range = NA, extrapolated_low = FALSE,
                  extrapolated_high = FALSE)
               s_full <- qed_date_to_season(src_date)
               for (sn in names(qed_seasons)) {
                  w <- which(s_full == sn)
                  if (!length(w)) next
                  f <- fc$fits[[sn]]
                  if (is.null(f)) f <- fc$fits[["annual"]]
                  if (is.null(f)) stop(sprintf(
                     "%s/%s/%s/%s: no fit for season %s and no annual fallback",
                     model, s, id, var, sn))
                  rr <- qed_apply_eqm(src_all[w], f, extrap)
                  appl$x_corrected[w]       <- rr$x_corrected
                  appl$within_range[w]      <- rr$within_range
                  appl$extrapolated_low[w]  <- rr$extrapolated_low
                  appl$extrapolated_high[w] <- rr$extrapolated_high
               }

               method_flag <- ifelse(is.na(appl$x_src), "source_nan",
                              ifelse(appl$extrapolated_low, "extrapolated_low",
                               ifelse(appl$extrapolated_high,
                                      "extrapolated_high", "within_range")))

               bad <- sum(is.na(appl$x_corrected) & !is.na(appl$x_src))
               if (bad > 0) stop(sprintf(
                  "%s/%s/%s/%s: %d corrected NaN with valid source",
                  model, s, id, var, bad))

               out <- data.table::data.table(
                  date = src_date, source_value = appl$x_src,
                  corrected_value = appl$x_corrected,
                  method_flag = method_flag)
               data.table::fwrite(out,
                  file.path(out_dir, paste0(id, "_", var, ".csv")))

               n_extrap <- sum(appl$extrapolated_low |
                                  appl$extrapolated_high)
               summary_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <- data.frame(
                  model, ssp = s, id, var, tier, status = fc$status,
                  n_overlap = fc$n_overlap, n_extrap = n_extrap,
                  frac_extrap = round(n_extrap / length(src_date), 4))
            }
            "ok"
         }, error = function(e) {
            qed_log(paste("ERROR", model, s, id, conditionMessage(e)),
                    qed_ssp_log_file)
            paste("error:", conditionMessage(e))
         })
      }
      rm(ssp_agg); invisible(gc())
      qed_log(paste("ssp done:", model, s), qed_ssp_log_file)
   }

   rm(hist_agg, fits_cache, agg_pr, agg_tx, agg_tn); invisible(gc())
   qed_log(paste("model done:", model), qed_ssp_log_file)
}

qed50_summary <- data.table::rbindlist(summary_rows, fill = TRUE)
data.table::fwrite(qed50_summary,
                   file.path(qed_ssp_dir, "qed_50_run_summary.csv"))
print(table(qed50_summary$status))
```

## 4. Verification

```{r verify}
made <- list.files(file.path(qed_ssp_dir, "qm_corrected"),
                   pattern = "_pr\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
cat("catchment pr series written:", length(made), "\n")
stopifnot(length(made) > 0)   # never wipe outputs on a config mistake

# spot-check one output: flags + gap accounting
one <- data.table::fread(made[1])
print(one[, .N, by = method_flag])
cat("gap rule: 'source_nan' includes Feb-29 of noleap models AND the\n",
    "2061-2080 window gap -- downstream counts these in n_gap_filled,\n",
    "never fills silently.\n")
qed_log("QED_50 done", qed_ssp_log_file)
```

**Handoff contract for downstream SSP modules:** corrected SSP series live at
`data_processed/ssp/qm_corrected/<model>/<ssp>/<tier>/<id>_<var>.csv` with
the same columns as the historical `qm_corrected/` tree, so the HYD-style
readers work unchanged. NAs mean: window gap (2061--2080), Feb-29 of noleap
models, or 360-day-calendar invalid dates -- always count, never fill.
`extrapolation_share` for SSP rows must be computed on the SSP window days.
